core_obligations: The authors maintain coupled upper and lower spectral barriers for irrevocable online row decisions, prove rank-one inverse-potential inequalities and conditional expected-potential bounds, and use the resulting amortized argument to obtain the expected sample-size bound while preserving the spectral sandwich always. The complete barrier algorithm and potential analysis are supplied; leverage-score variants and matching lower-bound context are not separately counted.
